units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|log|38|0
units.english: The Rulei were likely an ancient, technologically advanced civilization from long ago, but the only things that remain of them are a single strange ship and two scarred planets.
units.italian: I Rulei erano probabilmente una civiltà antica e tecnologicamente avanzata di molto tempo fa, ma di loro restano solo una strana nave e due pianeti segnati.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|They communicate through some sort of invasive psionic ability, speaking in a thousand voices all at once. Prolonged contact seems unhealthy.|39|0
units.english: They communicate through some sort of invasive psionic ability, speaking in a thousand voices all at once. Prolonged contact seems unhealthy.
units.italian: Comunicano tramite una sorta di capacità psionica invasiva, parlando con mille voci tutte insieme. Un contatto prolungato sembra malsano.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|Moments after entering the system, you are overwhelmed by an intense sense of emptiness. As you attempt to comprehend this feeling, you begin hearing whispers from behind.|41|0
units.english: Moments after entering the system, you are overwhelmed by an intense sense of emptiness. As you attempt to comprehend this feeling, you begin hearing whispers from behind.
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo essere entrato nel sistema, sei sopraffatto da un intenso senso di vuoto. Mentre cerchi di capire questa sensazione, cominci a sentire dei sussurri alle spalle.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	(Turn around slowly.)|43|0
units.english: (Turn around slowly.)
units.italian: (Girati lentamente.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	(Pull out my sidearm and turn quickly.)|44|0
units.english: (Pull out my sidearm and turn quickly.)
units.italian: (Estrai l'arma corta e girati in fretta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	You turn around, but nothing is there besides the familiar internals of your ship. The whispers remain behind your head, like an itch that can't be reached. The whispers are in a completely foreign language that you can't even begin to understand. As you keep looking around, you begin hearing more and more murmuring. There feels to be hundreds of distinct voices tugging your mind in every direction at once now, overloading your senses. Just as you think you can't take anymore, everything falls completely silent.|45|0
units.english: You turn around, but nothing is there besides the familiar internals of your ship. The whispers remain behind your head, like an itch that can't be reached. The whispers are in a completely foreign language that you can't even begin to understand. As you keep looking around, you begin hearing more and more murmuring. There feels to be hundreds of distinct voices tugging your mind in every direction at once now, overloading your senses. Just as you think you can't take anymore, everything falls completely silent.
units.italian: Ti giri, ma non c'è nulla oltre agli interni familiari della tua nave. I sussurri restano dietro la tua testa, come un prurito che non riesci a raggiungere. I sussurri sono in una lingua del tutto straniera che non riesci nemmeno a iniziare a capire. Continuando a guardarti intorno, cominci a sentire sempre più mormorii. Sembrano esserci centinaia di voci distinte che ti tirano la mente in ogni direzione insieme, sovraccaricando i sensi. Proprio quando pensi di non poterne più, tutto cade in un silenzio completo.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Hello?"|47|0
units.english: "Hello?"
units.italian: "Pronto?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Is there someone there?"|48|0
units.english: "Is there someone there?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcuno lì?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Show yourself!"|49|0
units.english: "Show yourself!"
units.italian: "Mostrati!"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Human."|51|0
units.english: "Human."
units.italian: "Umano."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	An image suddenly flashes in your head as you feel millions of eyes staring at you from beyond the boundaries of space. Looking around again, you see a strange-looking spacecraft a bit off into the distance in front of you facing your direction. The voices continue to surround your mind with only slightly reduced intensity.|52|0
units.english: An image suddenly flashes in your head as you feel millions of eyes staring at you from beyond the boundaries of space. Looking around again, you see a strange-looking spacecraft a bit off into the distance in front of you facing your direction. The voices continue to surround your mind with only slightly reduced intensity.
units.italian: Un'immagine ti lampeggia all'improvviso nella testa, mentre senti milioni di occhi fissarti da oltre i confini dello spazio. Guardandoti di nuovo intorno, vedi un veicolo spaziale dall'aspetto strano poco più avanti, che ti fronteggia. Le voci continuano a circondare la tua mente con un'intensità appena ridotta.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Who are you?"|54|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Where am I?"|55|0
units.english: "Where am I?"
units.italian: "Dove sono?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	Numerous voices start up, but rather than becoming louder, they go back and forth in your head, as though they are having a discussion. After a few seconds, they fall silent, then speak a single word in a cacophonous unison.|57|0
units.english: Numerous voices start up, but rather than becoming louder, they go back and forth in your head, as though they are having a discussion. After a few seconds, they fall silent, then speak a single word in a cacophonous unison.
units.italian: Numerose voci si destano, ma invece di farsi più forti vanno avanti e indietro nella tua testa, come se stessero discutendo. Dopo qualche secondo tacciono, poi pronunciano una sola parola in un unisono cacofonico.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Precursors."|58|0
units.english: "Precursors."
units.italian: "Precursori."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"What is this place?"|60|0
units.english: "What is this place?"
units.italian: "Che posto è questo?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"Precursors of what?"|61|0
units.english: "Precursors of what?"
units.italian: "Precursori di che cosa?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	The whispers start to pick up with renewed strength. The swirl of endless vocals assaults your head, each moment more agonizing than the last. Finally, they cease, and you are left in silence.|63|0
units.english: The whispers start to pick up with renewed strength. The swirl of endless vocals assaults your head, each moment more agonizing than the last. Finally, they cease, and you are left in silence.
units.italian: I sussurri riprendono con forza rinnovata. Il turbine di voci senza fine ti assalta la testa, e ogni istante è più atroce del precedente. Alla fine cessano, e resti nel silenzio.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"An End."|64|0
units.english: "An End."
units.italian: "Una Fine."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"An end to what?"|66|0
units.english: "An end to what?"
units.italian: "Una fine di che cosa?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	"What do you mean by that?"|67|0
units.english: "What do you mean by that?"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi con questo?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	The voices resume, but you sense a newfound dreariness in their tone. You try once again to communicate with the ship, but despite constant whispering in the background, it no longer answers.|68|0
units.english: The voices resume, but you sense a newfound dreariness in their tone. You try once again to communicate with the ship, but despite constant whispering in the background, it no longer answers.
units.italian: Le voci riprendono, ma percepisci nel loro tono una tetraggine nuova. Provi ancora una volta a comunicare con la nave, ma nonostante il sussurro costante sullo sfondo non risponde più.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	Taking another look at the vessel, it seems to have some sort of advanced origin. Eerie star-like patterns flow on its surface, and it doesn't visibly have any standard means of propulsion. At the rear end is some type of floating ring of objects that rotate in a peculiar manner.|69|0
units.english: Taking another look at the vessel, it seems to have some sort of advanced origin. Eerie star-like patterns flow on its surface, and it doesn't visibly have any standard means of propulsion. At the rear end is some type of floating ring of objects that rotate in a peculiar manner.
units.italian: Guardando di nuovo il veicolo, sembra avere un'origine in qualche modo avanzata. Sulla sua superficie scorrono inquietanti motivi simili a stelle, e non ha visibilmente alcun mezzo di propulsione standard. A poppa c'è una sorta di anello sospeso di oggetti che ruotano in modo bizzarro.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Rulei|	The planets in this system seem to have an abnormal appearance similar to that of the starship, but for some reason even looking at them gives you a headache. Something unusual must have happened here a long time ago.|70|0
units.english: The planets in this system seem to have an abnormal appearance similar to that of the starship, but for some reason even looking at them gives you a headache. Something unusual must have happened here a long time ago.
units.italian: I pianeti di questo sistema hanno un aspetto anormale, simile a quello dell'astronave, ma per qualche motivo anche solo guardarli ti fa venire mal di testa. Qualcosa di insolito deve essere accaduto qui molto tempo fa.

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|It feels as though there is a tremendous weight on your mind while you visit this world. The same sort of purple starlit hues of the alien ship from above can also be found in various strange formations across the land. Unlike the whispers from before, the voices here are painfully unbearable, especially the closer you get to the surface.|93|0
units.english: It feels as though there is a tremendous weight on your mind while you visit this world. The same sort of purple starlit hues of the alien ship from above can also be found in various strange formations across the land. Unlike the whispers from before, the voices here are painfully unbearable, especially the closer you get to the surface.
units.italian: Mentre visiti questo mondo, hai la sensazione di un peso tremendo sulla mente. Le stesse tonalità violacee, simili a stelle, della nave aliena vista dall'alto si ritrovano anche in varie formazioni strane sparse per la terra. A differenza dei sussurri di prima, qui le voci sono dolorosamente insopportabili, soprattutto man mano che ti avvicini alla superficie.

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|	You can barely hear yourself think.|94|0
units.english: You can barely hear yourself think.
units.italian: Riesci a malapena a sentire i tuoi pensieri.

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|											It's enough to drive any living thing mad.|95|0
units.english: It's enough to drive any living thing mad.
units.italian: Basta a far impazzire qualsiasi essere vivente.

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|	The most ominous sensation here is a persistent feeling of your consciousness being pulled at from beneath you.|96|0
units.english: The most ominous sensation here is a persistent feeling of your consciousness being pulled at from beneath you.
units.italian: La sensazione più inquietante è quella persistente di una coscienza che viene tirata da sotto di te.

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|	Like something is attempting to drag|97|0
units.english: Like something is attempting to drag
units.italian: Come se qualcosa stesse cercando di trascinare

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|																					your|98|0
units.english: your
units.italian: la tua

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|																							mind into the planet below.|99|0
units.english: mind into the planet below.
units.italian: mente nel pianeta qui sotto.

units.id: mission:Rulei Planet|	It's best you don't remain here for too long.|103|0
units.english: It's best you don't remain here for too long.
units.italian: Meglio non restare qui troppo a lungo.

units.id: mission:Rulei: You Are (Not) Alone: L-118|log|116|0
units.english: Discovered a region of emptiness east of the core, where systems are shrouded by a vast, eerie darkness. Other than dim stars and a few planets, nothing exists.
units.italian: Scoperta una regione di vuoto a est del nucleo, dove i sistemi sono avvolti da un'oscurità vasta e inquietante. A parte stelle fioche e qualche pianeta, non esiste nulla.

units.id: mission:Rulei: You Are (Not) Alone: L-118|Upon arriving into this system, you notice a strange murkiness curtaining the stars beyond, and your scanners are having trouble making sense of it. The few stellar objects present are eerily blotted out by a vast, nebulous shade. Aside from them, it's as if there is nothing here. Even the shade itself is nothing more than the emptiness of space, and throughout it, no one. Nothing.|118|0
units.english: Upon arriving into this system, you notice a strange murkiness curtaining the stars beyond, and your scanners are having trouble making sense of it. The few stellar objects present are eerily blotted out by a vast, nebulous shade. Aside from them, it's as if there is nothing here. Even the shade itself is nothing more than the emptiness of space, and throughout it, no one. Nothing.
units.italian: Entrando in questo sistema, noti una strana torbidezza che vela le stelle oltre, e i tuoi scanner faticano a darne una lettura coerente. I pochi oggetti stellari presenti sono cancellati in modo inquietante da un'ombra vasta e nebulosa. A parte loro, è come se qui non ci fosse nulla. Perfino l'ombra stessa non è altro che il vuoto dello spazio, e in tutto quel vuoto, nessuno. Niente.

units.id: mission:Rulei: You Are (Not) Alone: L-6181|As you continue through this empty space, you come across nothing but diminished stars and planets of silence. However, upon entering this system, you are met with what appears to be a creature of some kind. Strangely, your scanners don't read it as any sort of lifeform, categorizing it only as a mere "collection" of matter. It blends with space itself, as if it were simply a reflection of the darkness beyond.|132|0
units.english: As you continue through this empty space, you come across nothing but diminished stars and planets of silence. However, upon entering this system, you are met with what appears to be a creature of some kind. Strangely, your scanners don't read it as any sort of lifeform, categorizing it only as a mere "collection" of matter. It blends with space itself, as if it were simply a reflection of the darkness beyond.
units.italian: Continuando attraverso questo spazio vuoto, non trovi altro che stelle sminuite e pianeti di silenzio. Entrando in questo sistema, però, ti imbatti in quella che sembra una creatura. Stranamente i tuoi scanner non la leggono come una qualche forma di vita, e la classificano solo come una mera "collezione" di materia. Si confonde con lo spazio stesso, come se fosse soltanto un riflesso del buio oltre.

units.id: mission:Rulei: Umbral Reach|log|151|0
units.english: The Rulei seem to acknowledge the void of systems east of the core as the "Umbral Reach", and appear to have some sort of emotional connection to the region. Other than stating to "beware" the area, they will not further comment on it.
units.italian: I Rulei sembrano riconoscere il vuoto dei sistemi a est del nucleo come l'"Umbral Reach", e paiono avere un qualche legame emotivo con quella regione. Oltre a dire di "stare in guardia" dalla zona, non vogliono commentare oltre.

units.id: mission:Rulei: Umbral Reach|Out of nowhere, the mysterious whispers of the Rulei seep into your mind once more. They murmur slowly at first, but grow faster and louder from the direction of the ancient vessel, eventually coalescing into one spoken phrase.|153|0
units.english: Out of nowhere, the mysterious whispers of the Rulei seep into your mind once more. They murmur slowly at first, but grow faster and louder from the direction of the ancient vessel, eventually coalescing into one spoken phrase.
units.italian: Dal nulla, i misteriosi sussurri dei Rulei ti si insinuano di nuovo nella mente. Dapprima mormorano lenti, ma dalla direzione dell'antico vascello crescono in velocità e volume, finché si fondono in un'unica frase pronunciata.

units.id: mission:Rulei: Umbral Reach|	"Beware..."|154|0
units.english: "Beware..."
units.italian: "State in guardia..."

units.id: mission:Rulei: Umbral Reach|	"...Umbral Reach..."|155|0
units.english: "...Umbral Reach..."
units.italian: "...Umbral Reach..."

units.id: mission:Rulei: Umbral Reach|	You feel tremendous weight behind the expression, as if it shook your mind itself. It's as though every emotion has flooded into your head at once - sadness, anger, joy, disgust, even some you can't seem to understand. Before you can respond to them, the voices quickly dissipate, and you're left alone in an uncomfortable silence.|156|0
units.english: You feel tremendous weight behind the expression, as if it shook your mind itself. It's as though every emotion has flooded into your head at once - sadness, anger, joy, disgust, even some you can't seem to understand. Before you can respond to them, the voices quickly dissipate, and you're left alone in an uncomfortable silence.
units.italian: Senti un peso tremendo dietro quell'espressione, come se ti avesse scosso la mente stessa. È come se ogni emozione ti fosse inondata la testa in una volta - tristezza, rabbia, gioia, disgusto, e perfino alcune che non riesci a capire. Prima che tu possa rispondere, le voci si dissolvono in fretta e resti solo in un silenzio scomodo.

units.id: mission:Rulei: Umbral Reach|	The only thing you can think of is the nearby void of desolate systems. Considering your previous experience with the Rulei, they could have somehow psionically connected to the memories of your visit. However, much like those systems, they continue with their unabated silence.|157|0
units.english: The only thing you can think of is the nearby void of desolate systems. Considering your previous experience with the Rulei, they could have somehow psionically connected to the memories of your visit. However, much like those systems, they continue with their unabated silence.
units.italian: L'unica cosa a cui riesci a pensare è il vicino vuoto di sistemi desolati. Considerata la tua precedente esperienza con i Rulei, potrebbero essersi in qualche modo collegati psionicamente ai ricordi della tua visita. Ma, proprio come quei sistemi, continuano nel loro silenzio ininterrotto.
